audit.summary: Theorem4.1 displacement bound is false on an admissible scalar instance and initial potential calculation drops a positive term. SAGA's unrestricted specified recurrence and Cor3.3 eta lower bound fail; a dependence-safe recurrence proof restores the core batch regime. A2's advertised nonmonotone example violates assumptions. Generic convergence order and empirical ranking are not declared false.
